description: React component for rendering and managing draft and scheduled post rows in Mattermost, including editing, scheduling, and error handling.

classes.name: DraftRow
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing individual draft or scheduled post entries, including editing, scheduling, and error display.

methods.name: DraftRow
methods.description: Main functional component rendering a draft or scheduled post row with editing and scheduling capabilities.

methods.name: goToMessage
methods.description: Navigates to the post or channel associated with the draft, handling thread and channel navigation.

methods.name: handleOnDelete
methods.description: Deletes the draft or scheduled post from local storage and state.

methods.name: afterSubmit
methods.description: Callback after a post is submitted, handling draft cleanup and scheduled post deletion.

methods.name: onScheduleDraft
methods.description: Schedules a draft to be posted at a specified time.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels editing mode for the draft.

methods.name: handleSchedulePostEdit
methods.description: Toggles editing mode for scheduled post.

methods.name: handleCopyText
methods.description: Copies the draft message text to clipboard.
